name: Central Region
eyebrow: Central Region · Marina Bay, Orchard and the old quarters
title: Central Region:
title_em: the city at the heart of Singapore.
tagline: Marina Bay, Orchard Road, Chinatown, Little India and the island resort of Sentosa.
summary: The Central Region is Singapore's core: its financial district, its main shopping belt and its oldest neighbourhoods, from Chinatown and Little India to Kampong Glam. It is also home to some of the island's greenest places, including the Botanic Gardens and Bukit Timah Nature Reserve.

Marina Bay, with Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay and the Singapore Flyer, is the skyline most people picture. Behind it are heritage shophouses, hawker centres and the national stadium at the Sports Hub.

sport.intro: The Singapore Sports Hub at Kallang holds the National Stadium, where the Lions play, and big concerts; Jalan Besar Stadium is a local football home.

community.intro: Many Singaporeans abroad are from the central neighbourhoods, and they carry Chinatown, Little India and Kampong Glam culture with them.

ancestry: Tracing your family in Singapore? The National Archives of Singapore and the National Library Board hold oral histories, newspapers, maps and records, and many are searchable online.
